# AX

AX is an AI-first explicit programming language for AI-written backend tools,
automation scripts, repairable CLI programs, and compiler-assisted agent
workflows.

Core idea:
- Explicit, low-ambiguity syntax for autoregressive coding models.
- Structured diagnostics exposed by `axc check --json`.
- AI repair contracts exposed by `axc check --json --ai`.
- Architecture context exposed by `axc context`.
- Repair benchmark evidence through export, run, score, compare, and archaeology workflows.

Primary commands:
- `axc check`
- `axc run`
- `axc fmt`
- `axc build`
- `axc context`

Portal sections:
- Docs: getting started, language guide, AI protocols, compiler internals.
- Packages: static catalog v0 for official `std.*` modules and representative examples.
- Benchmarks: repair evidence, smoke suites, deterministic replay.
- Repair: cold/base/ai repair feedback comparison.
- Context: overview, boundaries, topology, flow, symbol, impact, evidence.
- Download: Windows full workflow, Linux core support, macOS planned later.

Repository:
https://github.com/AX-FDN/AX
